wifi_setup.title: Set up Wi-Fi over Bluetooth
wifi_setup.description: Put the kettle in Wi-Fi setup mode from its menu first, and keep the Fellow app closed (it holds the Bluetooth connection, and its own setup also makes the kettle download new firmware). Home Assistant then sends the network details straight to the kettle; nothing goes through Fellow's servers.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Set scheduled time/temperature and optionally enable the schedule.

disable_schedule.name: Disable schedule
disable_schedule.description: Disable scheduled start on the kettle.

update_schedule.name: Update schedule
update_schedule.description: Apply the current schedule time/temp/mode from entities to the kettle.

heat_to.name: Heat to temperature
heat_to.description: Set the target temperature and start heating in one call.

play_chime.name: Play chime
play_chime.description: Play a chime on the kettle's buzzer.

send_cli.name: Send CLI command
send_cli.description: Read-only diagnostic CLI command: state, fwinfo, prtsettings or pwmprt.

install_firmware.name: Install firmware (temporarily disabled)
install_firmware.description: Temporarily disabled on all transports pending safety and recovery validation. Retained for compatibility; no file is read and no kettle command is sent.

path.name: Firmware file path
path.description: Absolute path to the .img file, readable by Home Assistant (e.g. under /config, /media or /share).

entry_id.description: Optional config entry id (needed if multiple kettles)
entry_id.name: Kettle (config entry)

get_settings_snapshot.name: Read settings snapshot
get_settings_snapshot.description: Read native/BLE settings for supervised testing. No setting or power command is sent. Contains clock/settings values, no network identifiers.

start_ble_trace.name: Start live BLE recording
start_ble_trace.description: Read-only B1/B5 recording, memory only, maximum 120 seconds.

get_ble_trace.name: Read live BLE recording
get_ble_trace.description: Read timestamped frames; stops recording by default.

probe_schedule_console.name: Probe schedule console
probe_schedule_console.description: Experimental: send one read-only prtsettings query and listen on B6 for eight seconds. Returns only recognized schedule fields and capture counts. Requires current standby state; no schedule or power setting is changed.

set_existing_schedule_mode.name: Change existing schedule mode (Wi-Fi)
set_existing_schedule_mode.description: Change a physically configured future schedule to once/daily, or disable it. Firmware 1.2.26 with Wi-Fi required. Once/daily cannot be read back: check the physical menu. Does not change time or temperature.

restore_standby_display.name: Restore standby display (Wi-Fi)
restore_standby_display.description: Temporarily turn the standby clock off and restore its original digital/analog mode. Requires firmware 1.2.26, Wi-Fi, standby and planning off. Check the visual result.

cli_muted.title: No valid CLI data
cli_muted.description: Firmware {version} does not return valid CLI data. Native HTTP is detected from valid responses; BLE is available for 1.2.26. This integration does not switch firmware automatically. The other partition reports {other_version}.

firmware_staged.title: Firmware {staged} is stored on the kettle
firmware_staged.description: The kettle runs {running}; partition {partition} contains {staged}, which may start after a restart. This integration monitors firmware changes and does not switch partitions automatically. Manage updates using the official device settings. Router controls can block internet access while retaining local Wi-Fi.
